title: Sean Mannion to continue calling offensive plays for Eagles, Joe Milton to remain at QB

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Sean Mannion to continue calling offensive plays for Eagles, Joe Milton to remain at QB
sources.description: Eagles head coach Nick Sirianni said that the team would talk about changes to roles and responsibilities on the coaching staff during their bye week, but he said on Wednesday that they decided against any major ones.
